title: How to Use Impeccable
body:
/impeccable init

This create a design.md and product.md

title: Driving exam tips
body:
- First check headrests of seats behind

- Make sure examiner's feet aren't on the yellow lines of banana

- On hill start, method 3: a. clutch in b. rev between 1.5 amd 2.6. c. release clutch until car elevates d. handbreak down e. revs and slowly release clutch

- From stopped, start releasing clutch while revving

- From 2nd, while moving, rev when clutch is AT BITING POINT

title: video
body:
Beat 1 — the platform (home page, ~15s)

Land on localhost:8787. Narrate: "This is the agent manager — each card is an agent." Point out Order
 Agent is live/Ready, the other two are greyed "Coming soon." Optionally click + New agent, fill the 
modal, hit Create — a new "Draft" card appears — narrate "spinning up a new agent is just describing what it should watch and where it should post." Then click into Order Agent.

Beat 2 — show the trigger (Gmail tab, ~10s)
Cut to Gmail. Show PO-2001 sitting unread in the inbox. This is your "before" shot.

Beat 3 — Fetch (console, Stage 1)
Back to console, click 1. Fetch. Live console streams real log output. Cut back to Gmail — the email is now read and labeled order-agent/processed. That label proves it's a live system, not canned data.

Beat 4 — Extract (Stage 2)
Click 2. Extract. The order appears in the Orders table with line items and confidence %. Narrate that this came from Claude reading the raw email text, not a template.

Beat 5 — Match (Stage 3)
Click 3. Match. Stepper advances, caption shows "Matched to Demo Wholesale Co." Cut to HubSpot, search/open that company record so viewers see the real object it matched against.

Beat 6 — Review gate (Stage 4)
Click 4. Review gate. Since PO-2001 is clean, it auto-approves — caption flips to "Approved — ready to post." (This is where PO-2002 would instead show up in the amber "Needs review" panel — approve it inline if you're running that second pass.)

Beat 7 — Post to OMS (Stage 5)
Click 5. Post to OMS. Caption updates to "Posted to QuickBooks · Estimate ###". Cut to the QuickBooks sandbox tab, open Estimates, show the new one with matching PO#, line items, and total.

Beat 8 — Sync CRM (Stage 6)
Click 6. Sync CRM. Caption updates to "Synced to HubSpot #...". Cut back to HubSpot, refresh the company/deal record, show the order summary that just landed on it.

Beat 9 — the one-click version
If you sent PO-2002, run it as a single Run all — stages 1 to 6 to contrast with the step-by-step walkthrough you just did — click Approve on the review-queue card mid-run, everything else keeps flowing.

Beat 10 — automation close
Click Schedule, show the Interval/Date range/Custom tabs, hit Start schedule, show the "Runs every 30 minutes" chip. Good closing line: "once it's tuned, it just runs."

Notes

- Don't cut to the .env file, terminal env vars, or the Intuit developer app's Keys tab — those are your real live credentials.
- The console's log panel only ever prints stage progress, not secrets — safe to show full-screen.
- If a stage button ever shows "0 new" mid-recording, it just means Gmail's already marked that email processed — check the Gmail tab, or send a fresh test email and re-shoot that segment.
